BL-1249 — The expeditor restarts the swarm without consulting any hold marker - it restarted against a live human 'hold restart' directive on 2026-08-28
What it solves: Minted 2026-08-28 ~14:45 BST by the specifier after finding the breach while taking the eleventh reading of the BL-1191 restart gate. Verified at mint that no ticket owns this: grepping backlog/paused, active, hold and done for expedite-plus-restart, restart-hold and control-pause matched only BL-1…
Approval context: An automated path overrode your 10:54Z "hold restart" directive today. Approving this authorises teaching the expeditor's final phase to read .swarmforge/operator/control-pause.json and refuse to start the swarm while a hold is in force, reporting the refusal loudly instead of quietly.
One call to …
BL-1249 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1249" (or "reject BL-1249 <reason>") to act.
